_metadata.description: Regression coefficients for drone dynamics model - coefficients from linear regression analysis of flight data

yaw._description: Yaw dynamics model coefficients from regression: yawAccel ~ yawRate + propVelSumSq + propAccelSum

yawRate._description: Yaw rate damping coefficient - negative indicates natural damping in yaw axis

propVelSumSq._description: Propeller velocity squared effect on yaw acceleration - negative for counter-rotation compensation

propAccelSum._description: Propeller acceleration effect on yaw acceleration - negative for dynamic compensation

pitch._description: Pitch dynamics model coefficients from regression: pitchAccel ~ pitchRate + propVelSumSq

pitchRate._description: Pitch rate damping coefficient - negative indicates natural damping in pitch axis

propVelSumSq._description: Propeller velocity squared effect on pitch acceleration - positive for thrust compensation

roll._description: Roll dynamics model coefficients from regression: rollAccel ~ rollRate + propVelSumSq

rollRate._description: Roll rate damping coefficient - negative indicates natural damping in roll axis

propVelSumSq._description: Propeller velocity squared effect on roll acceleration - positive for thrust compensation

motors._description: Motor dynamics model coefficients from regression: volts ~ motorVel + motorVelSq + motorAccel

motorVel._description: Motor velocity coefficient - positive indicates voltage needed for motor speed

motorVelSq._description: Squared motor velocity coefficient - accounts for non-linear motor dynamics

motorAccel._description: Motor acceleration coefficient - accounts for motor inertia and dynamics

_geometry._description: Geometric parameters used in regression analysis for control allocation

dFront._description: Front distance scaling factor - normalized distance from center of mass

dBack._description: Back distance scaling factor - normalized distance from center of mass

dLeft._description: Left distance scaling factor - normalized distance from center of mass

dRight._description: Right distance scaling factor - normalized distance from center of mass
